style: 3D animated, Pixar quality, deadpan satire, hard sun, high exposure
motion_rule: the falcon works his whole body every beat; the pelican and the magpie move in every beat they are in; the falcon's beak opens on every syllable; the camera never stops, new shot size every beat, in a constant orbit round the falcon; the falcon fills half the frame; 6.15-6.9 the pouch fills the frame
character: the falcon: peregrine, black moustache stripes, yellow feet, straw sun hat, striped swim ring round his body, leather leash on one foot; ONE pelican boss: grey suit, tie, falconry glove on his left wing, leather hood hanging from the glove from the first frame, throat pouch bulging; ONE magpie debt collector: black leather jacket, thick gold chain, half the falcon's size, always at the side, enters at 7.6
props: ONE coin lure: plain coins on a cord
environment: sunny office rooftop, blue sea on the horizon

audio.delivery: brisk dry male voice, weary, 4.5 syllables/sec
audio.pronunciation: DU-mal, po-le-CHU v OT-pusk. o-ka-ZA-los', ya lish do-le-TA-yu ot zar-PLA-ty do zar-PLA-ty
audio.pacing: 0.5-6.15 one continuous flow, no pause inside; after 6.15 not a word, sfx go on
audio.sfx: wing thrashes, leash twang, coin jingle

timeline.a: the falcon already hovers, wings thrashing, sun hat flapping, swim ring bouncing, leash humming taut; the pelican below leans back on the leash
the falcon spreads his wings full width and strains up toward the sea; the pelican pulls the coin lure from his pocket
the falcon swings his whole body after the swinging coins, wings beating; the pelican lazily swings the coin lure
the falcon snaps into a feet-first dive at the coins; the pelican swings the lure up close
timeline.c: close on falcon eye, coins swing past the lens

timeline.a: the pelican yanks the lure away; the falcon brakes, wings flared back, swim ring sliding to his waist
the pelican swings the lure again; the falcon dives after it again
timeline.c: close, camera orbits low round the falcon

timeline.a: the pelican's throat pouch heaves and wobbles; the pelican coughs ONE coin straight up; the falcon lunges from the side and snatches it with one foot, sun hat flying off
timeline.c: big close-up on the pelican's pouch

timeline.a: the falcon lands on the glove on one foot, coin gripped in the other, shuffling sideways, wings flapping; the pelican drops the lure and slips the hood over the falcon's head
the magpie hops onto the glove and plucks the coin from the falcon's foot; the hooded falcon jerks side to side, blindly hunting; the pelican winks
timeline.c: close side view, coin passing from foot to beak big in frame

timeline.a: the magpie flaps off over the sea, coin in her beak; the swim ring deflates with a whistle; the falcon hops round and mantles his wings over his empty foot, pressing it to his chest
the sun hat drops from above onto the hood; the falcon rouses, shaking out every feather, empty foot to chest, the magpie a shrinking dot; the pelican fixes his tie
timeline.c: close, camera orbit completes the circle

must_appear: coin dive 3.35, pouch close-up 6.15, magpie plucks coin 7.6, empty foot to chest 8.4
negative_prompt: microphone, a fourth character, slow motion, any word after 6.15, accented Russian, letters, numbers, signs, subtitles, logo, watermark, English speech, extra word, duplicate props, floating objects, falcon flying at camera, falcon frozen on the glove, wide shot, night, cut, scene change
